entries.description: A pickpocket eyes the party's coin purse — Torren would notice on a passive Perception check.
Two Watch officers stop the party for a routine check. No trouble unless the party escalates.
A drunk brawler stumbles from a tavern, insults the tallest party member. Non-lethal fistfight or de-escalation.
A begging orphan tugs at a sleeve — genuine, hungry. Optional roleplay hook, no combat.
A Guilded Veil courier hurries past, a wax-sealed letter tucked into their sleeve. Follow?
A crumpled pamphlet blows past — Naturus doctrine, freshly printed. Trail leads somewhere?
A back-alley robbery in progress — 3 thugs shaking down a merchant. Intervene?
Vaeloran's coach clatters past. Does he wave? Look through them? Stop?
A whispering shadow follows the party for two blocks then vanishes. Sylas senses illusion.
Cult ambush — 4 cultists step from an alley, weapons drawn. This is Kaelith's people testing the party.
A wight prowls the Undercroft — undead loose in the city. Someone is losing control of the dead.

tables.body:
# Aeloria Streets — Random Encounters

Roll d100 when the party spends a full period (morning / afternoon / evening / night) traversing Aeloria without a specific destination, OR when narrative pace demands a beat and there's no scripted event pending.

## Weighting notes
The bottom of the table (89-100) skews darker as the campaign progresses. Early game, reroll 89-100. Post-Session 4 (party knows Kaelith is active), 89-95 becomes plausible. Post-Session 7 (Vaeloran unmasked), 96-100 becomes plausible.

entries.description: Uneventful — merchant caravan passes, exchanges news. Roleplay/rumour hook.
A lone traveller in bad shape asks for escort to the next town. Genuine, no trick.
A wolf pack, hungry — 4 wolves. Standard threat.
Bandits — 4 lay in wait behind an overturned cart. Classic ambush.
Highway robbery — a captain and thugs. Well-organized, will parley if outmatched.
An orc raiding party moved south from the mountains. Rare this far, and worrying.
A hobgoblin patrol — disciplined, banner-bearing. War-party scout ahead of something bigger.
A manticore descends from a rocky ridge, testing whether these travellers are prey.
A cult ambush — the Guilded Veil has agents on the roads too. Assassin plus spies. Not looking to kill; looking to slow the party's arrival.

tables.body:
# Aelorian Roads — Random Encounters

Roll d100 per travel-day watch when the party is on any Aelorian road not otherwise scripted. Roads between Aeloria Crossroads and outlying settlements are patrolled but not safe; roads further out get progressively wilder.

## Weighting notes
Between Aeloria and Ironhold, add +5 (heavier bandit activity around Halvor's trade routes). Beyond the Northern Reaches border, add +15 (frontier).

entries.description: Sinking mud slows progress. Con save DC 10 or one PC's boot is swallowed; 1d4 minutes lost.
A pack of wolves — normal, hungry, wary. Not corrupted. Half will flee if two drop.
A traveller's abandoned camp. Recent. Bloody drag marks lead into the reeds. Investigation hook.
Giant spiders in a dead-tree canopy. Ambush attack from above.
The marsh gas has a green tinge here — Naturus-touched. A brown bear, corruption-bloated, charges.
A giant crocodile in the deep water, drawn by the party's noise.
Kaelith's cult cell moves through the marsh, gathering something. 4 cultists + fanatic.
A dire wolf leading a pack — corruption in its eyes. Uncharacteristically aggressive.
Something old moves in the deep marsh. Just for a moment. The party sees eyes the size of dinner plates and hears water displace. Then nothing. Foreshadow.

tables.body:
# Frostwood Marsh — Random Encounters

Roll d100 per travel-day watch. The marsh is a Naturus-touched region — the corruption is stronger toward the interior. Rolls skew stranger and more corrupted the further in the party gets.

## Weighting notes
Add +10 to the roll each additional day the party spends in the marsh. Corruption stacks.

entries.description: Halvor's enforcers move in a group of three — casually surveying, cataloguing faces. If the party looks like trouble, they follow.
A worker with a limp offers a whispered warning about the compound guards' shift change. Reward for trust.
Ironhold Watch patrol — the corrupt kind. Two guards and a captain looking for an excuse to fine someone.
A funeral procession — worker crushed in the foundry. Grief-stricken family. Roleplay hook to Sera.
A locked warehouse — no guards visible. Curiosity bait. What's inside?
Halvor's compound is on lockdown tonight. Movement in and out is being logged. Any approach requires stealth or disguise.
A courier with an urgent message runs past — envelope bears the Guilded Veil sigil. Intercept?
Sera Vey herself appears — desperate, seeking news of Mira. Emotional beat.
An ambush — Halvor knows the party is in town. 2 thugs plus an assassin, hit-and-run.
Something moved in the foundry chimneys — a scout of the deeper things stirring beneath Ironhold. Vrass-adjacent (if you want to seed the dragon early).

tables.body:
# Ironhold Streets — Random Encounters

Roll d100 when the party spends a full period in Ironhold without a specific destination. Ironhold is more overtly hostile than Aeloria — most rolls trend toward pressure, surveillance, or intimidation.

## Weighting notes
If the party has NOT yet acted against Halvor: reroll 93-97 (he doesn't know they're a threat yet). Post-Halvor confrontation, all rolls in play.
